newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CCT rights issue 1.43 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: CCT rights issue 1.43 times subscribed.

text.p: Telecommunications equipment maker CCT Telecom Holdings Ltd, formerly China Treasure Telecom Holdings Ltd, said in a statement on Monday its latest rights issue had been 1.43 times subscribed.
Last month, the firm obtained an approval to raise net proceeds of about HK$99 million through a one-for-one rights issue of 613.36 million rights shares at HK$0.17 each.

Of the net proceeds, about HK$20 million would be used to repay bank borrowings, HK$40 million to repay the principal amount of the company's convertible note, and the balance to provide addtional working capital, the firm said.
It said the rights issue lowered its gearing ratio to 0.14 time, but did not give a former figure for comparison.
The company makes and distributes corded and cordless telephones, telephone answering machines and facsmile machines.
